subject_read: iconic working dwarf, compact and sturdy rather than tall human; immediately readable at native 16×24 scale

canonical_description.helmet: oversized rounded BLUE metal helmet with a centered amber lamp
canonical_description.eye: one black eye Cell when exposed, no white sclera
canonical_description.belt: dark leather belt with small amber buckle
canonical_description.pickaxe: compact heavy pickaxe resting behind the right shoulder

generation_source.purpose: detailed image-edit generation base for walk

notes: Walk image-edit uses TWO files. (1) generation_source = assets/first-room/dwarf/idle/provider/source.png — the provider transport strip with four identical idle Frames; seed via `npm run strip:polish -- seed --identity-declaration assets/first-room/dwarf/identity.json --out <seed.png>` (applies seed_pad_px: 64 magenta border around the generation_source interior) and submit <seed.png> as the image-edit base (edit_source_sha256 must equal the padded seed digest from seed --json, not raw generation_source.sha256; init/check verify that transform). generation_source is deliberately NOT palette-exact: the palette migration (#176-#179) requantized identity_png and the Release Frames onto the Master Palette but left this provider raster off-palette, because it is the walk image-edit generation base rather than a Release asset and _verify_release never inspects it. Do not assume it conforms to assets/palettes/first-room.json, and do not requantize it to make it match identity_png. (2) identity_png = assets/first-room/dwarf/identity.png — the 16x24 palette-exact post-ingest Release anchor for Identity Lock only; bind as --identity-reference, never upscale into a generation canvas. The seed command does NOT take identity.png as input. After generation, do not paint Identity Lock or flat identity colors into provider/source.png (nor wipe magenta / shift Frames) to force Gate PASS — regenerate until lock and baseline pass on the unmodified provider Attempt. Swing Cell-authored acquisition does NOT use generation_source or seed_pad_px. All four swing Frames start from assets/first-room/dwarf/idle/release/frame-0.png (Release Frame 0), whose bytes equal identity_png at planning time. Author the checked-in motion-pose-plan/0 through strip:author with base mapping [0, 0, 0, 0], then initialize via strip:polish init-cell. Do not submit a swing provider edit, upscale identity.png, or generate a pose-reference image.
